Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații
📣 Would you like to join a company that puts people at the heart of its concerns? We are waiting for you! Since 2007, Extia, an IT consulting company, has been offering a unique approach in its field by combining well-being at work and performance.
 Our philosophy at Extia is “First who, then what", so let's go for it!
 🚀First who?
You are a self-starter and a problem solver with a strong "one team" and "T-shaped" mindset.
You are a decision-maker who can weigh up options to reach the right conclusions.
You are well-organized, able to plan your own work, and track progress against a plan.
You are a strong communicator (written & verbal), able to easily explain technical issues and solutions to peers.
 This role is hybrid, 5 days/MONTH from the office in Bucharest 
 🚀Then what?
 QA Automation Engineer with Java and Selenium, with the following tasks:
Development of new automated tests that ensure the quality of new feature development, covering both functional and non-functional tests.
Assurance of the quality of new features developed for the platform, ensuring software meets or exceeds published metrics and quality benchmarks.
Act as a fully engaged member of the Scrum Team, taking responsibility for the effective resolution of issues as they arise.
Drive improvements to quality assurance and ensure adherence to standards and best practices.
Mentor and transfer knowledge to more junior QA engineers, ensuring knowledge is spread across squads and teams.
Work collaboratively to ensure deliveries are on time and to a high quality.
 Required technical skills:
Strong commercial experience as a Java Automated QA using Java and Selenium .
Commercial experience testing systems that incorporate microservice architectures and web applications.
Good experience with TDD and BDD tools and techniques (e.g., JUnit, Cucumber).
Solid understanding of DevOps practices, principles, and data creation/curation.
Experience with Performance & load testing, Security testing, and UI & accessibility testing.
Understanding of containerization concepts.
 Nice to have / Big plus: Experience with AWS/Cloud providers, Spring Boot, tokenization, XML/JSON, and working with large databases.
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the "Who" and represent the "What"? Apply and let's talk!
